diffuseAlbedo.source: Substances/plaster-of-paris.json: unverified luminous reflectance of a cast face (0.80 to 0.92)
diffuseAlbedo.note: The middle of the unverified range, a faint warm cast of the gypsum's natural colour; the ground gypsum's 0.774 is a powder, not a cast face.

refractiveIndex.derivation: the mean of gypsum's three principal indices

porosity.source: Substances/plaster-of-paris.json: physical.porosity (0.5, derived from bulk and gypsum densities)

wettingDepth.note: A first depth of a cast face whose pores govern its look.

grain.note: Set gypsum is a felt of needles tens of micrometres long: finer than the eye resolves.

bed.note: The reach of the mould's face.

bedAspect.source: A cast body has no bedding

toneSpread.note: A cast face is nearly even.

roughnessSpread.note: A first half-range across a cast face.
